title: Boy in Overalls, Mother and Baby on Lawn - Vintage 1940s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: An intimate post-World War II family snapshot taken in a suburban yard. In the foreground, a young boy in denim overalls and a white t-shirt looks toward the camera, with a metal or cast toy airplane resting on the grass beside him. In the background stands his mother in a printed floral summer dress carrying a toddler on her hip, looking toward a two-story clapboard house. The scene captures post-war American domesticity and everyday family life.
